@set.g.library: Settings group names (left column of Settings). Groups are found by a stable id, so translate freely.
set.g.library_sub: Where your footage lives. Files are read in place and never changed.
set.g.player_sub: Your names in the kill feed decide whether a line is a kill, a death or a squad mate's.
set.g.audio_sub: Read from your OBS profile at startup. Settings here win over the measured values.
set.g.encoding_sub: Clips and proxies. OBS records on the graphics card's one NVENC engine.
set.g.clippool_sub: Make clip saves moments as files here, with every audio track. This folder is never scanned as footage.
set.g.hardware_sub: Your graphics cards and what WardogClips may use them for.
set.g.vods_sub: Stream VOD import: YouTube, Twitch, Kick, TikTok, Rumble.
set.g.updates_sub: WardogClips looks for a newer version and asks you before it downloads or installs anything.
set.g.performance_sub: Keep the PC usable while WardogClips works.
set.g.addons_sub: Optional downloads: faster speech on NVIDIA graphics cards, the YouTube helper, speech models and updates for the VOD downloader. Nothing downloads unless you click.
set.g.clipcache_sub: Player clips and per-track window audio, rebuilt when needed. Proxies stay.
set.f.library.roots: Library folders (one per line; read in place, never changed)
set.f.library.min_age_s: Skip files changed in the last (seconds), as they are still recording
set.f.library.auto_scan_new: Watch the library folders while running
set.f.player.aliases: Your in-game name(s) (separate with ;, no clan tag)
set.f.audio.track_names: OBS track names 1-6 (separate with ;, read from OBS while empty)
set.f.audio.mic_track: Your mic track number (starts at 0; -1 = find it by name)
set.f.audio.voip_track: Squad / Discord track number (starts at 0; -1 = automatic)
set.f.audio.game_track: Game audio track number (starts at 0; -1 = automatic)
set.f.audio.normalize_mic: Make a quiet mic louder (for speech-to-text and clips)
set.f.stt.model: Whisper model (switching unloads the current one)
set.f.stt.redetect_windows: Detect the language again for every line (only with Detect automatically; for squads that switch languages mid-game)
set.f.stt.translate: Also write an English translation of lines in other languages (search finds both; large-v3-turbo does not translate well)
set.f.stt.vad: Find the speech first (voice activity detection)
set.f.stt.batched: Batched decoding (speech pieces decoded in parallel; faster on long files)
set.f.stt.hotwords: Extra words to listen for (separate with ;, player and squad names are always added)
set.f.jobs.auto_detect: Detect events in every newly probed recording
set.f.jobs.parallel: Footage jobs per drive (auto = from the drive benchmark)
set.f.jobs.gpu_parallel: Video jobs at once on each graphics card in use (all drives); new threads start after a restart
set.f.jobs.auto_bench: Benchmark each drive once in the background (when idle)
set.f.detection.roi_fps: HUD crops per second (full first pass)
set.f.detection.ocr_fast_ticker: Fast OCR for the reward ticker: about 2.7 times faster, but it missed about 1 in 10 kill / assist lines on 3440x1440 footage
set.f.detection.ticker_reuse: Reuse the last ticker reading while the ticker has not changed
set.f.detection.ocr_device: Read HUD text on (auto = the graphics card while nothing else, such as a game, is using it, otherwise the processor)
set.f.detection.ticker_every: Read the ticker on every Nth keyframe. Keep 1: 2 halved the reading time but lost about 1 event in 3 in tests (fewer ticker reads mean fewer kill feed reads)
set.f.highlights.rms_spike_db: Voice excitement: level over the recent background level (dB, used at the next transcription)
set.f.proxies.dir: Proxy folder (empty = the proxies folder in the data folder)
set.f.proxies.codec: Proxy encoder (libx264 = the processor, which keeps NVENC free for OBS; auto = NVENC only while OBS is not using it)
set.f.proxies.clip_codec: Clip encoder for the player (same choices)
set.f.clippool.dir: Clip folder (leave empty for Videos\WardogClips\Clips in your user folder)
set.f.clippool.mode: How clips are made: copy is instant and lossless but starts on the nearest keyframe (up to about 2 seconds early); exact starts on the exact frame and re-encodes the picture, which is slower
set.f.clippool.crf: Picture quality for exact clips (lower is better and bigger; 16 looks like the recording)
set.f.hardware.auto_gpu_encoder: Let auto use the video encoder of an AMD or Intel card (off: x264 on the processor)
set.f.vods.dir: Folder for the provider folders (empty = Videos\WardogClips VODs in your user folder)
set.f.vods.max_height: Best quality up to (height in pixels)
set.f.vods.add_to_library: Add the VOD folder to the library folders on the first import
set.f.resolve.launch_on_start: Start Resolve with WardogClips (if it is not running) and wait for a project
set.f.resolve.launch_on_send: A hand-off while Resolve is closed starts it, waits for a project, then runs
set.f.resolve.project: Open this project automatically (empty = wait for you to open one)
@set.f.resolve.selects_name: {token} is the text the user types into the field to get the date (it shows as the word date in braces); keep it.
set.f.resolve.selects_name: Selects timeline name ({token} becomes the date)
set.f.server.verbose_console: DEBUG lines in the console window
set.f.updates.channel: Update channel (beta also offers test versions)
@set.opt.auto: Choice names in Settings lists; the stored value stays the same.
set.stt.engine_missing: Engine: faster-whisper is NOT installed (reinstall WardogClips)
set.cal_label: Calibration page: HUD boxes, ticker wording, your name
set.up_label: Look for a newer release now
@set.enc.now_html: Keep the <b> tags around the values. "auto" is a choice name in the encoder list.
set.enc.now_html: Right now clips encode with {clip} and proxies with {proxy}. "auto" would pick {auto}: {why}

set.enc.sessions.one: ({count} NVENC session open on the graphics card)
set.enc.sessions.other: ({count} NVENC sessions open on the graphics card)

set.ao.ytdlp_title: Downloads a newer VOD downloader (yt-dlp) when there is one. Try this when stream downloads stop working.
set.ao.setup_title: The first-run questions again: footage folders, your name, speech, stream recordings
set.cc.clear_title: Delete every cached clip and per-track window audio (proxies stay)

set.cc.usage.one: {count} cached item, {used} of {cap} (the oldest go first past that)
set.cc.usage.other: {count} cached items, {used} of {cap} (the oldest go first past that)

set.cc.cleared_kept.one: Clip cache cleared: {count} item, {freed} freed ({left} in use, kept)
set.cc.cleared_kept.other: Clip cache cleared: {count} items, {freed} freed ({left} in use, kept)

@set.sys.log_html: Keep the <span> tag around {path}. {level} is a log level name such as INFO.
set.sys.log_tail: Open the end of the log
set.library_changed: Library settings changed. Scan new applies them.
pal.marker: Marker for this event in Resolve

pal.kw.clip_folder: make clip pool saved clips explorer
@help.g.playback: Keyboard shortcuts overlay (?). Key names on the key caps are not translated.
help.rec_top: Move this recording to the top of the queue
help.jobs_topbottom: Move selected jobs to the top / bottom
